title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ\-EQ**
 We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end\-to\-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 6,500\+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top\-15 private equity firms.
   

  

 Our services are underpinned by a Group\-wide commitment to ESG and best\-in\-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in\-house experts.
   

  

 Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.
   

  

 We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Introduction**
 We are seeking a proactive and technically skilled Application Support Analyst to provide application support, maintenance, and continuous improvement across a diverse software portfolio. In this role, you will work closely with Product Management, Service Hub, vendors, and IT teams to troubleshoot complex issues, deliver enhancements, manage application performance, and ensure business\-critical systems remain reliable, scalable, and aligned with operational and strategic objectives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* You'll provide technical application support and maintenance across the software portfolio, acting as an escalation point for the Service Hub and resolving complex incidents, requests, and service issues in line with established ITSM processes and SLA commitments.
* You'll collaborate with Product Management, business stakeholders, vendors, and technology teams to manage product backlogs, support roadmaps, improve application capabilities, conduct service reviews, and ensure operational availability targets are achieved.
* You'll deliver functional and technical enhancements, support project implementations and transitions into business\-as\-usual operations and contribute to both Agile and Waterfall initiatives.
* You'll perform incident, trend, and backlog analysis; create management information (MI) and reporting packs; maintain knowledge base articles; and drive continuous service improvements across the application estate.
* You'll troubleshoot application, database, and infrastructure\-related issues, manage stakeholder communications, identify improvement opportunities, and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, suppliers, and external service providers.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health \& Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances \& Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.


**Qualifications**
**About You**
* You have a degree\-level qualification (preferred) and experience supporting enterprise applications within structured IT environments, with a strong understanding of ITSM frameworks such as ITIL or COBIT and service delivery best practices.
* You possess excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with hands\-on experience in application support, application development concepts, database technologies, infrastructure platforms, third\-party system implementations, and software development methodologies.
* You have advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills for troubleshooting, optimization, and process enhancement, along with experience supporting SSRS (mandatory), Power BI, Crystal Reports, source control tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, or SVN, and PowerShell scripting.
* You are experienced working with SaaS and on\-premises applications, vendors, system migrations, and integrations, and ideally have exposure to Tableau, wealth management platforms, CRM, GRC, finance systems, or the financial services sector.
* You communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences, demonstrate strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, collaboration, and influencing skills, and are comfortable working in a customer\-focused, service\-driven environment with excellent written and spoken English.


**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
   

  

 Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
   

  

 We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: IT Associate (JOB ID : 186) – Marlarmyaing Agrochemical Company Limited
description:
**Role Summary**
 The Senior IT Associate is a pivotal member of the technology team, responsible for maintaining, optimizing, and securing our corporate IT infrastructure. This role combines hands\-on technical troubleshooting with helping junior staff and managing asset lifecycles. You will serve as a point of escalation for complex issues and play a key role in on\-call crisis response to ensure business continuity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure \& Networking**
* Monitor office network health and performance, ensuring high availability of corporate resources.
* Implement and enforce security protocols in alignment with industry standards.


**IT Service \& Asset Management**
* Manage the full lifecycle of IT assets, from procurement and imaging to decommissioning.
* Administer ITSM platforms to ensure tickets are categorized, tracked, and resolved within SLA.
* Follow service management process, track hardware inventory, and software licenses.


**Tactical Problem\-Solving**
* Escalation: Act as the primary level\-1 and level\-2 support for complex hardware and software issues.
* On\-Call Response: Lead the resolution efforts during critical system outages or security incidents.


**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a related field.
* Experience: 2\+ years of professional experience in IT operations and infrastructure.
* Technical Skills: Proven track record in troubleshooting complex environments and managing on\-call crisis response.


**Preferred (The “Standout” Candidate)**
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree specifically in Information Systems or Computer Science.
* Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation (for service management excellence).
* Microsoft Certifications (M365\).
* CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate).


**Core Competencies**
* Communication: Ability to translate complex technical jargon into actionable insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Sociability: Maintain good relationship with end\-users.
* Resilience: Calm under pressure during system crises and tactical “firefighting.”
* Proactivity: A mindset focused on preventing issues before they occur through robust operational maintenance.

title: Senior IT Associate (JOB ID : 154) – Marlarmyaing Agrochemical Company Limited

 Job Specification

title: Storage Engineer III
description:
**Overview**
 Storage Engineer III with minimum experience of 8 years, he/she will be responsible for the 24/7 support, installation, and maintenance of all storage and components within RealPage global datacenters.
   

  

 They will assist product support teams with technical questions, application troubleshooting, or other systems problems.
   

  

 The engineer will manage and support Engineering labs and data centers.
   

  

 An ideal candidate will be well organized and detail oriented, possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, and have excellent communication skills.
   

  

 The role also entails strong execution and focus to meet the needs of Realpage’s internal and external customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver technology solutions focused around the entire life\-cycle of data in a high growth, highly technical environment.
* Provides functional and technical expertise with managing, implementing, and designing data \& storage environments.
* Execute solutions for environments such as highly active databases, email servers, multimedia access, development, and highly available or disaster recovery environments.
* Ensures that all capabilities delivered align with original business objectives , business process , development framework, service levels, and design intent.
* Responsible for driving and delivering on strategic planning, design, and support of global storage infrastructure, data center and cloud solutions.
* Ability to drive output in a highly collaborative environment with the ability to organize and coordinate teams towards a common goal.
* Provides technical system troubleshooting; Oversight and accountability for resolution of outages, service level issues, and user/customer support needs in coordination with Operations Support Center.
* Ensures technical documentation is kept up to date (architecture / integration diagrams and documentation).
* Create and maintain policies and procedures for storage technologies.
* Integrate storage platforms with AI\-enabled monitoring tools \& Capacity planning
* Deploy and manage Rancher\-based Kubernetes clusters for containerized workloads


**Qualifications**
* Experience building scalable, highly available , mission critical storage infrastructures.
* Experience should include designing, implementing, and managing high performance block (SAN) and file (NAS) storage.
* Expertise on EMC Powermax , Unisphere, powerstore and symcli required .
* Expertise on SRDF concepts and Symmrecovery .
* Working knowledge of  enterprise level Brocade DCX required .
* Storage and Fabric upgrades.
* Expertise of NAS storage systems (Isilon) required .
* Skilled at performance analysis, Capacity planning.
* Troubleshooting performance issues, fabric issues.
* Handoff experience of planning \& performing Storage migrations.
* Co\-ordinating with Vendor for Hardware issues and regular health checks of the environment.
* Knowledge of backup/VMware technologies.
* Knowledge on Cloud \& Automation.
* Experience with Disaster Recovery
* Flexible to work overtime as required ; some overnight work may be required .
* Able to sit or stand for frequent periods in the same location with some opportunity to move about.
* Able to stoop or lift material or equipment up to 50 pounds.

title: Payee Services Representative
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Client Service Representative role supports healthcare providers with their electronic healthcare insurance payments. This role assists with providing payment details, guidance on payment processing, product enrollment, and online portal registration while following the federal HIPAA laws.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Handle incoming calls from our provider clients to answer questions regarding their payments and enrollment.
* Works to resolve any outstanding issues related to their payments including explaining the use of our electronic payment options (credit cards, direct electronic funds transfer)
* Assist providers in signing up for direct electronic funds transfer products as well as assisting with the registration process, online web portal set\-up and provider portal guidance including basic troubleshooting.
* Navigate Zelis platforms and processes efficiently with the goal of providing quick and thorough responses to our clients with first call resolution.
* Build and maintain a thorough knowledge of Zelis Payments products and solutions.
* Build and maintain a thorough knowledge of company policies and procedures, especially related to provider privacy.
* Maintaining scheduled adherence and remaining productive throughout your given shift.
* Ability to consistently meet monthly stat expectations and attendance goals.
* Maintain and display a positive attitude.


**Professional Experience**
* 1\-3 years of experience in customer service and helping people
* Passion for customer service and helping people.
* Excellent telephone etiquette and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency in problem\-solving and basic troubleshooting
* Computer proficiency and technical aptitude
* Attention to detail.
* Consistent and reliable
* Comfort with MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Demonstrated resilience and resourcefulness in customer service situations.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s degree is a must.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Senior Payments Specialist
description:
Zenoti provides an all\-in\-one, cloud\-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built\-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise\-level technology for businesses of all sizes
   

  

 Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand \& Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair \& Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI\&GUY.
   

  

 Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest\-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021\-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com
   

  

**What will I be doing?**
* Processing Payment metrics (decline rates, processing, payouts, etc.)
* Proactively communicating on Production issues to customers.
* Handling Disputes and consulting with merchants when they need help managing their disputes or trends
* Tracking Operational task efficiency (onboarding merchants, device logistics and support, working with partners to hold them accountable for SLAs, etc.)
* Identifying and executing opportunities to automate or outsource activities
* Partnering with product engineering to ensure the product and features are operable by design
* Partnering with Processors to resolve high priority Operation issues.
* Representing the platform in customer discussions and handle escalated accounts due to operational issues
* Driving RCA and other feedback and data analysis to learn from current and improve the future


**What Skills do I need?**
* Ability to handle escalations and resolve issues quickly
* Experience in Payments domain is highly desirable.
* 5\-8 years of experience in managing payment/acquiring operations for a payment processor, banks, or other financial institutions.
* Exposure to global payments landscape is preferred.
* Strong Communication Skills
* Self\-motivation and goal\-orientation, desire to deliver results
* Ability to work with multiple teams to achieve results
* Manage end\-to\-end US payroll processing activities, ensuring timely and accurate payroll execution.
* Handle payroll compliance activities including federal/state tax regulations, deductions, filings, and audit support.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to resolve payroll discrepancies and ensure compliance with US payroll policies and regulations.
* Ready to work in Shifts across different time zones.


**Why Zenoti?**
* Be part of an innovative company that is revolutionizing the wellness and beauty industry.
* Work with a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth.
* Opportunity to lead impactful projects and help shape the global success of Zenoti’s platform.
* Attractive compensation.
